verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Checkouts API lets an agent submit a product URL plus spending cap and Crossmint completes the checkout, with order lifecycle tracked via polling (docs-4, docs-15, supp-7) — this is a documented protocol call to create an order draft. However, it's poll-only with no webhooks or staging environment in v1, and there's no explicit 'update' semantics for an existing cart/order beyond creation and polling status. missing for 10: documented update/modify-order-draft endpoint (not just create+poll), webhook-based lifecycle events for checkouts (docs-18 covers general payments not agent checkouts specifically), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
